meta.display: The Sarrow Vale — the province pack v0.1 (world-2 L2, slice 1)
meta.notes: world-2 level 2, slice 1 (iter-118): a fantasy province at pack scale — authored pillars over a generated surface (phases.md §6, D-130's sketch; the Qud split). ORIGINAL nouns (the posture tier: the repo's public 2nd setting is original — D-015/REFERENCES §10; the level-1 reskin instrument was the OPEN generic stack, this is not). The skeleton slice: the 324-site map, the river-artery lattice, the settlements, the cast WITH spine records (the AP crosswalk's first consumer — D-148/D-152: the first pack to carry spine records gets them lint-checked), the T1 twin. The cultures (name-1 profiles, the condensation travelers), the factions triangle, the feud history and the calendar are the follow-up slices (the wave plan, TASKS world-2). Every value is pack data, never code (INV-3).

locations.name: the Sarrow road
locations.role: the travel spine: journeys start and land here
locations.notes: the valley road between the weir stair and the half-pay keep — the artery's own spine (the road_pack's loc_street shape, the hub the player starts on); open ground, no sight lines into interiors

locations.name: the weir stair
locations.role: the crossing: the Sarrow leaves the hills here, the toll is taken
locations.notes: Ketta's weir — the road crosses the Sarrow by the stair; the boathouse timbers the only burnable thing on the bank (the flood took the rest)

locations.name: the half-pay keep
locations.role: the garrison post: the levy road passes the gate; the relief's rest post
locations.notes: the under-paid garrison on the shoulder above Malby — the watch pair swaps between this rest post and the market duty post (crime_watch.rotation); the hearth the only lit fire in the province's interiors

locations.name: Malby, the market town
locations.role: the wealth node: the weighbeam, the stalls, the rumor scene (mandatory: this is where hearsay lives)
locations.notes: the bank market on the navigable Sarrow — the seed settlement's continuity (the v0.1 tavern/street/market cluster grown into a town, D-130's polygon); the duty post of the watch pair, the crowd listener lives here; the stall row the market's fire exposure

locations.name: the smelt crofts
locations.role: the iron: the hill folk's bloom fires behind the keep
locations.notes: Garrick's camp — the charcoal stacks are the province's worst fire trap (the smelting camp is a standing hazard by design, mid-grim); the estranged half of the province (the cultures row's hill folk — name-1 profiles ride the follow-up slice)

locations.name: Thornmill, the tithe manor
locations.role: the old families' seat: the burned mill, the grief, the tithe barn (the arson target)
locations.notes: the old family's seat — the feud's fire took the mill a generation back (the worldgen chronicle owns the story, the collections: feud/quarrel); the tithe barn the present arson target; unlit — the burned mill stays dark (the acquisition's night-fidelity step, the road's unlit-open-ground law)

npcs.name: the factor's runner
npcs.role: a downstream trading house's errand-audit up-country
npcs.goal: audit the convoy debts, be home before the rains
npcs.notes: starts on the artery and walks the province (the smoke script's own walk); crime_status is the crime_watch convention (rules.json crime_watch.status_values); carries the house waybill book (the manifest-check family's target — the document_check demand reads it)

npcs.name: Ketta
npcs.role: the weir keeper, toll-taker of the crossing

spine.flaw: the crossing answers the heaviest purse
spine.cause: the flood year drowned the family punt and the savings with it

npcs.notes: the crossing's toll-keeper — the spine's flaw rides the coerce urgency entry (AP-8's consuming rule: the double toll when a rich-seeming traveler crosses); the punt pole the family's last tool (items)

npcs.name: Osgar
npcs.role: the half-pay watch sergeant, duty post at Malby

spine.flaw: the levy bends for whoever feeds it
spine.cause: the crown's quartermaster shorted the garrison two winters running

npcs.notes: the duty holder at the market post (the rotation's outgoing; pickpocket target — the pay tin is thin this season, the expectations rule's item); the spine's flaw rides the manifest-demand urgency entry (AP-8: the fed levy leans on strangers' papers)

npcs.name: Ferra
npcs.notes: receives Osgar's knowledge at watch change (transfer event); pair trust 75 — colleagues (P2a, D-020); the pair.pc_01.suspicion home (suspectaxis-2, D-102); the manifest-check relief hook's target (the document-check family's second arm)

npcs.name: Maren
npcs.role: Malby's market mistress, keeper of the weighbeam

spine.flaw: the scales tilt for old coin
spine.cause: the feud burned her mother's stall and the family credit never recovered

npcs.notes: the wealth node's voice — the spine's flaw rides the talk urgency entry (AP-8: the well-reputed stranger gets her small talk, the scales tilt for old coin); the storm murmur hook's target (weather-1's seeded consequence, the market watching the rain eat the stalls)

npcs.name: Garrick

spine.flaw: the iron hides when prices fall
spine.cause: the guild factor shaved the weight two seasons back and the camp starved

npcs.notes: the hill folk's voice at the iron camp — the spine's flaw rides the linger urgency entry (AP-8: the bloom held back when the price turns); the charcoal sack is his camp's (items)

npcs.name: Wilmot
npcs.role: Thornmill's steward, keeper of a burned name

spine.cause: the feud's fire took the mill and the young heir together

npcs.notes: the old families' voice — the spine's flaw rides the ramble urgency entry (AP-8: the grief-ramble to no one in particular, the drunk's ambient shape re-voiced mid-grim); intoxication 30 — the grey-brew (the jug, items) feeds his witness quality (the §6 intersection matrix)

ambient_entities.name: the market queue
ambient_entities.notes: passive knowledge-holder and rumor listener (MVP_SCOPE §4.2): the bank crowd at the weighbeam — no goals, no relations, no movement — receives knowledge records only

items.name: the tallow lamp
items.notes: fire source; breakable — the drop_break target that starts the arson chain on the road (the runner's own lamp, the §3 walkthrough shape)

items.name: the garrison pay tin
items.notes: Osgar's levy tin, thin this season — the steal target; the expectations rule's item (the inferred-tin-missing ladder's anchor)

items.name: the jug of grey-brew
items.notes: the steward's grief-brew — the intoxication vector feeding Wilmot's witness quality (the road's mead-jug shape, re-voiced)

items.name: the tally staff
items.notes: Maren's market staff, beside the weighbeam (the cudgel analog — the keep-peace of the market town)

items.name: the charcoal sack
items.notes: the crofts' utility sack, by the stacks — the flammable prop at the camp (the road's hawser shape)
